QuestInfo.name: Monstrous Tree Stumpy
QuestInfo.0: Doctor #p512# seems to have one last request.
QuestInfo.1: Visited Doctor #p512# again. He says #o700007# seems to take all the nutrients from #m10004000#. He also added that if this continues, #m10004000# would become a wasteland devoid of life. The #r#o700007##k must be eliminated.
QuestInfo.2: Acting on Doctor #p512#'s request, I've tracked down and eliminated #o700007# that was nourishing on #m10004000#. Will this help #m10004000# return to its original state?

0.0: Welcome. I've been inspecting the #t4031137# you've brought, and I'm confident that my theory is true. However, the problem is that the results are much more serious than we expected.
0.1: I see I'm losing you. The #o700007# weren't nourishing on the #o6#s. They've been nourishing on #m10004000#. The #o6#s weren't being dried up, but instead couldn't find nourishment from the ground itself.
0.2: This is very dreadful situation. If this goes on #m10004000# will become a wasteland. You must help me once again.

yes.0: #o700007# is a very evil being. It's not only almost invincible, but also dries out the life out of everything else. Getting rid of #r#o700007##k is the only way to save #m10004000#. Please track down and defeat #o700007#.

no.0: You still don't understand, do you? This is a matter of life and death! Unbelievable! Coward!

1.0: You’re back. How did it go? Oh my... I see. Try to feel the strength of the earth itself. Then you’ll feel better. You’ve done an honorable deed.

yes.0: However, I still feel uneasy. #b#m10004000##k has suffered the most. It feels like we’ll never get our forest back to its original, healthy state.

mob.0: Sorry, but I have no clue where to find #o700007#. I apologize that I can't be of much help. Nevertheless, you still need to defeat #r#o700007##k. You understand, don't you?
